Vocabulary.boundary: Canonical lemma, sense, reading/POS, stage and collisions must be human-approved; dynamic AI is not canonical.

Grammar.boundary: Scope, formula, contrast, level and progression require editorial ownership.

Curated_Examples.boundary: Validate naturalness, form targeting, polarity/question/register coverage and vocabulary difficulty before insertion.

Expressions.strategy: Derived from existing canonical items first; otherwise AI-assisted + review
Expressions.boundary: Each core expression needs a communicative function and vocabulary/grammar linkage.

Dialogues.strategy: Editorial task design + AI-assisted drafting + native review
Dialogues.boundary: Require role, context, 3–5 turn goal progression, repair/follow-up and register checks.

Dynamic_AI_Examples.boundary: Ephemeral expansion layer; never counted as curated coverage and never written to curriculum.
